title: Conquistador
summary: Conquistador is a tall, clockwork Meso-Titan that is adept at guarding treasures. His red and gold armor resembles traditional Spanish garb. Conquistador was used by Hernán Cortés, one of the Spanish conquistadores.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
A Conquistador Titan was used by Hernán Cortés and was left to guard the conqueror's treasures inside his vault. [The Power of Umbra]

Centuries later, Dante Vale, intent on recovering Umbra's Ring, discovered the tomb but was unable to enter its vault due to a magical barrier that could only be disabled by Conquistador from within. [Gremlow Infestation!]

The team realized that Conquistador could be charmed into letting them into the vault using the Pied Pipe. While doing this, Wilder and his team captured them and Cherit was left to play the pipe. After the two teams began to fight, Cherit dropped the pipe in order that he could help out, leading to Conquistador becoming uncharmed.

Conquistador focused his attacks only on the Huntik team after they recovered Umbra. After defeating both Enfluxion and Kaioh the Tracker, Conquistador advanced on the Huntik team. As a final resort, Dante used Umbra's power to teleport safely away from Conquistador's clutches. [The Power of Umbra]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Conquistador has the ability '''Relentless Guard''', which makes the him become insurmountable when he is guarding treasure. This great warrior is deadly in close combat, with his enormous size giving him a huge physical advantage. He wields a huge Conquistador's sword, defeating his enemies with a single hit. Even though the old Spanish armor he bears is rusty, it is still very effective. {{source|The Power of Umbra}}
